slides.say: Use form status, from react dom, tells a component about the form it sits inside.
Pending is true while the parent form is submitting an Action. It reads the form as if it were a context provider.
The trap: it does not track a form rendered in the same component. Here pending never becomes true.

slides.text: Call it in a component rendered INSIDE the <form>.
slides.say: Fix: call it from a component rendered inside the form, like a Submit button component.
